title: What You Write Before They Leave

questions.stem: An older adult was admitted after a fall on a benzodiazepine. On the discharge list, that medicine should be:

options.text: Renewed at the same dose automatically
Taken off if it contributed to the admission

questions.explanation: If a benzodiazepine helped cause the admission, take it off the discharge list.

questions.stem: Sliding-scale insulin alone, as the discharge diabetes plan for an older adult, is:

options.text: A high-risk plan to remove, not a plan to copy forward

questions.explanation: Sliding-scale insulin alone is a high-risk plan to take off the list.

questions.stem: If an opioid is started at discharge, the prescription should be:

options.text: Immediate release, at the lowest effective dose
A week's worth of a patch, always

questions.explanation: Immediate release, lowest effective dose. Do not start extended-release in someone who has not been on an opioid.

questions.stem: When overdose risk is present and an opioid is started, also order:
questions.explanation: Order naloxone if the risk is there.

questions.stem: A depression screen at discharge without a follow-up slot this week is:

options.text: A reason to start an extended-release opioid

questions.explanation: If you screen, the order includes a follow-up slot and a way to diagnose and treat.

questions.stem: A positive test for stomach bacteria (Helicobacter). The discharge plan is:

options.text: A full eradication regimen and a test of cure

questions.explanation: A full regimen and a test of cure, not acid medicine alone.

questions.stem: For a breast, pelvic, or genital exam, the note should:

options.text: Omit the chaperone to protect privacy
Name the chaperone, or record that the patient declined one after it was offered
List a family member as the chaperone without asking
Skip documentation if the exam was brief

questions.explanation: The note names the chaperone or the declined offer.

questions.stem: A strong anticholinergic that caused confusion in an older adult should, at discharge, be:

options.text: Renewed to prevent withdrawal of confusion

questions.explanation: Take the culprit off the discharge list.

questions.stem: An opioid-naïve patient is leaving the hospital. An extended-release opioid:

options.text: Should not be the starting opioid
Is required for a depression screen

questions.explanation: Do not start an extended-release opioid in a person who has not been on one.

questions.stem: Acid medicine alone after a positive Helicobacter test:

options.text: Replaces the test of cure and the regimen

questions.explanation: Acid medicine alone is not treatment.
